name: B2
description: Explore-phase swing (2026-11-08): A0 plus repo field guides as ADK skills. One guide per known repo (built from the dev split only: where fixes land, source->test pairs, test command, traps) and new-repo-guide, which derives a guide at run time for a repo with no guide (scripts/scout.py, inheriting the shared patterns). Hypothesis: most A0 time goes to orientation; a guide cuts it, and the traps cut wrong-place and test-tampering failures.
